title: A discourse analysis of fuel subsidy reduction: Revisiting the political economy of Indonesia’s experiences 1998–2019
core_idea: To revisit the political economy of Indonesia's fuel subsidy reforms (1998–2019) by analyzing media discourse—using purposively sampled news articles from two outlets—to identify key actors and narratives that shaped reform trajectories.
tldr: Uses discourse analysis of Indonesian media coverage (1998–2019) to explore actors and narratives around fuel subsidy reduction and to provide a political-economy perspective for scholars and policymakers.
